headlines.title: Cooper Flagg scores 33 as Mavericks keep Warriors winless since Stephen Curry's injury
headlines.desc: — Cooper Flagg scored 33 points, P.J. Washington Jr. added 21 and the Dallas Mavericks stopped a three-game losing streak with a 116-94 victory over the Golden State Warriors on Wednesday night.

headlines.title: Davis and Dybantsa lead the Wizards past the Raptors 103-99 in a matchup of struggling teams
headlines.desc: — Anthony Davis had 25 points and 14 rebounds, rookie AJ Dybantsa added 23 points and 12 boards, and the Washington Wizards beat the undermanned Toronto Raptors 103-99 on Wednesday night to snap an eight-game losing streak.

headlines.desc: Josh Giddey was one assist shy of a triple-double, putting up 18 points, 14 rebounds, and 9 assists in a huge win for the Chicago Bulls over the Brooklyn Nets.

headlines.title: Embiid, Edgecombe, James power the 76ers to a 121-116 win over Magic
headlines.desc: — Joel Embiid scored 26 points, VJ Edgecombe added a season-high 24 and LeBron James finished with 22 as the Philadelphia 76ers beat Orlando 121-116 on Wednesday night, halting the Magic's four-game winning streak.

headlines.desc: — Matas Buzelis scored a season-high 25 points, Josh Giddey had 18 points, 14 rebounds and nine assists, and the Chicago Bulls rolled to their easiest victory of the season by beating the Brooklyn Nets 137-107 on Wednesday night.

headlines.title: Giannis gets win over Bucks in 1st meeting as Heat hang on late for 137-130 victory
headlines.desc: — Giannis Antetokounmpo scored 27 points and nearly got a triple-double in his first game against his former franchise, Bam Adebayo had 21 of his 26 points in the first half and the sizzling Miami Heat downed the sliding Milwaukee Bucks 137-130 on...

headlines.title: Grizzlies beat Cavaliers 124-121 for a franchise-record 8th straight road win
headlines.desc: — Cam Spencer scored 26 points, Taylor Hendricks added 20, including a key pair of free throws with 2.3 seconds remaining, and the Memphis Grizzlies set a franchise record with their eighth straight road win, defeating the Cleveland Cavaliers 124-121...
